_readme: Every word on the landing page — the vandana gate at the repository root.
THIS FILE IS THE TEXT. index.html holds no prose of its own: change a word here
and the page says it. There is no second copy to keep in step.
brand.latin        the masthead
brand.tagline      the line under it, clamped to two lines with a Read more
guru               his name in Devanagari and Latin, his title, the Know More label

vandana the verse (HTML allowed,
for the line break) and its
transliteration
labels             every button and hint on the first screen
sections           the contributor bands, in the order they appear. Each has
id, icon, eyebrow, name, sub, meta[], blurb, items[],
panel (which Know More sheet it opens), moreLabel, todo
panels             the Know More sheets, keyed by the name a section's
`panel` gives. Each has eyebrow, title, reverence, body,
groups[] (heading, icon, entries[] of name + note), closing
footer.lines       the closing lines, each { sa, latin }
todo               on a section: a dashed placeholder shown in its place.
Delete the key once the real text is written.
ICONS are drawn, not emoji — name one of: quill, book, people, seated, temple,
lotus, anjali, home, lamp, seed. An unknown name simply draws nothing.
How the page behaves — where it leads, whether respects are required, where the
flowers land — is admin/config/home.json, not this file.

brand.tagline: A digital initiative to preserve, organize and present the complete heritage of our Veda, Vedāṅga, Vedānta, Nyāya, Mīmāṃsā, Itihāsa, Purāṇa, Jyotiṣa, Arthaśāstra, Kāmaśāstra, Nāṭyaśāstra, Kāvya, Stotra and Dāsa Sāhitya in one place — with authenticity and devotion.

भागण्णार्य कृपापात्रं नित्यं भागवते रतम् ।
विश्वेशकरजं वंदे विश्वनंदनभिक्षुकम् ॥

sections.name: Tribhuvan Achar
sections.blurb:
The Sarvamūla Digital Library is a humble attempt to build a Kāmadhenu for scholars, researchers, students, and seekers of Śāstric knowledge — bringing scattered texts and sources together into an interconnected digital knowledge tradition.
Sacred knowledge has journeyed from oral tradition → manuscripts → print → digital text → interconnected digital knowledge.
DGE is an attempt to serve that next transition responsibly, preserving the richness of the tradition while using modern technology to make it more accessible, discoverable, and interconnected.

swamiji.title: Śrī Viśvanandana Tīrtha
swamiji.body: Recipient of the grace of Śrī Bhāgaṇṇārya, ever devoted to the Bhāgavata, ordained by the hand of Śrī Viśveśa — I bow to the mendicant Śrī Viśvanandana. So the vandana above reads.
swamiji.todo: To fill in: his āśrama lineage, his maṭha, and a short account of his life and teaching.

tribhuvan.title: Gurus, Blessers & Inspirers
tribhuvan.reverence: With gratitude and reverence to my Gurus and well-wishers who guided, inspired and strengthened this journey. I bow to them at whose feet this seva is offered.

entries.name: Smt. Nalini & Sri Raghavendra Rao
entries.note: To whom everything owes its beginning.

entries.name: Shri Hanasoge Prathoshachar
entries.note: The central guiding light of my spiritual journey, under whom my ultimate studies take place. He initiated me into the Sarvamūla Granthas — the very core of my life's pursuit and the primary focus of this library. Under his direct, continuous guidance I am studying the entire Sarvamūla and the Ṛg Veda. Through his Mantropadeśa and profound teachings he steers my path, holding the highest and most central importance in my life and my highest calling.

entries.name: Shri Raghavendra Achar
entries.note: Dāsa Sāhitya, the Prameya granthas, and Purāṇas.

groups.heading: Under whose teaching I have studied

entries.name: Shri Manojachar
entries.note: Māyāvāda Khaṇḍana and Viṣṇu Tattva Vinirṇaya.

entries.name: Shri Padmanabhacharya Chittuguppa
entries.note: Tattva Saṅkhyāna, Tattva Viveka and Upādhi Khaṇḍana.

entries.name: Shri Tulasi Kumar Joshi & Mayank Pandey
Veerasimha & Venkatanatha
entries.note: Śāstropakāra — steady help in the study of śāstra.

entries.name: Shri Vishwanandana Tīrtharu
entries.note: The ultimate fortune of serving a great soul. Through his dharma-dīkṣā my journey found its true elevation and divine refuge.

groups.heading: Śikṣā Guru & Gṛhastha-Dharma-Upadeṣṭā — roots and foundation

entries.name: Shri Jalihal Sukeshachar
entries.note: He provided the essential structure to my early spiritual life, teaching the foundational texts — Śabda, Maṇimañjarī, Purāṇa. As my sahadharmacāriṇī-yojaka he took immense pains to orchestrate my marriage, ensuring I found a spouse who supported my strict orthodox practices, and firmly guided my entry into the Gṛhasthāśrama.

entries.name: Shri Balagaru Shrinivasachar
entries.note: He awakened my spiritual journey, blessed my family through the Harivaṃśa Purāṇa, and gave me the conviction to leave the corporate world for my true svadharma. His posthumous grace through a profound svapna-darśana remains the quiet anchor of my daily sevā.

tribhuvan.closing: Śrī Śrīpādarāja, Śrī Bhūtarāja & Śrī Vādirāja — my life and breath.
